requirements.general: Entry Level and Requirements Foundation: Foundation in Business Programme, Minimum CGPA 2.50 Diploma: A relevant diploma with a CGPA of at least 2.50 from another institution A-Level : 2 Grade D, and a credit in Mathematics STPM : Grade C+ (GP 2.33) in any 2 subjects, and credits in Mathematics STAM : Grade Jayyid and a credit in Mathematics UEC : 5 subjects at grade B including a pass in Mathematics and English SACE : 5 subjects with ATAR of 55 and a credit in Mathematics NSW (HSC) : 10 units with ATAR of 55 and a credit in Mathematics CPU : 6 passes with an average of 60 Tertiary Entrance Examination (TEE) : 4 or 5 subjects with ATAR of 55 and a credit in Mathematics at SPM level Australian Year 12 : TER/UAI/ENTER 55 Matriculation/Pre-University - Completion of Matriculation/Pre-University programme with minimum CGPA of 2.5 Note: International students are subject to meet entry requirements that reflect similar qualifications and experience as stated above.
